s0465: Identify heat transfer by conduction in a solid (a metal)
s0466: Distinguish the three ways heat is transferred: conduction, through the particles of a solid; convection, with currents in a liquid or gas; and radiation, by rays, even through empty space.

s0474: The vibration of particles is passed on
s0475: Heated particles make neighboring particles vibrate too, and in this way heat spreads along the spoon.
